entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF88602. It's for the cycling shoes.
Thank you. I'm pulling that up now. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They gave me horrible blisters on my last ride. I can't wear them. And the cleats feel... off. They're just not right.
I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes caused blisters. That sounds uncomfortable. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see the shoes were delivered 44 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Whatever. So you'll take them back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email address on your account. You can just print that out, place the shoes back in the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued.
Right. Should have just worked in the first place.
I understand your frustration. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
